text: The operator's last ore carrier left with the administrators, the payroll, and the medical stores. No ships returned for you and the remaining families and crew. Before supplies ran out you managed to furnish enough spare parts to bring and old abandoned Cerberus online. With a chance of survival restored the ship was named the Second Wind, and people prepared to depart for a new life after a near decade in the belt. Somewhere between the locks and the jump point, they started calling you Commander. You have 473 credits, a down payment Castle will not let anyone touch, twelve unpaid security personel, and a port berth waiting on Jangala. This start replaces the Galatia tutorial with the Second Wind prologue and Marines Mod company campaign start.
